verdict.rationale: The evidence shows building blocks for AI over your data rather than a turnkey in-product insights feature. Vertex AI is positioned for building enterprise AI agents, and the MCP Toolbox for Databases offers NL2SQL and semantic search so agents can query enterprise databases. Getting insights this way requires building or connecting your own agent. missing for 10: a native in-console feature that generates insights or suggestions from user data, documentation of AI-generated recommendations inside the product, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
